description: This file defines the class 'FieldStorageConfigListBuilder' which builds a listing interface for field storage configurations in Drupal's field_ui module.

classes.name: FieldStorageConfigListBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds a list of field storage configurations for Drupal's field UI module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list builder with entity type, entity type manager, field type manager, and bundle info service.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of the list builder using dependency injection container.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares the render array and attaches the necessary library for the UI.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the list table, including field name, entity type, field type, usage, and settings summary.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a data row for each field storage entity, including handling locked fields, displaying type, usage, and settings summary.
